name: props_hx_ntu_limits
source:
{ Heat-exchanger effectiveness at the two asymptotes -- NTU -> 0 and NTU -> inf --
  for EVERY arrangement, at Cr = 0 (the boiling/condensing short-circuit that
  bypasses the switch entirely), Cr = 1 (the counterflow removable singularity,
  guarded by |cr - 1| < 1e-10), and Cr just inside that 1e-10 window on both sides.
  Then the same limits through the inverse relation NTU(eps, Cr). }

{ --- NTU -> 0 : every arrangement must give exactly 0 --- }
z_cf_0    = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 0, 0.5)
z_pf_0    = hx_effectiveness('parallelflow', 0, 0.5)
z_xu_0    = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 0, 0.5)
z_xmax_0  = hx_effectiveness('crossflowcmaxmixed', 0, 0.5)
z_xmin_0  = hx_effectiveness('crossflowcminmixed', 0, 0.5)
z_st_0    = hx_effectiveness('shelltube', 0, 0.5)
z_cf_0_c0 = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 0, 0)
z_xu_0_c1 = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 0, 1)

{ --- NTU tiny but non-zero: the NTU^0.22 / NTU^0.78 powers in crossflow bite here }
z_xu_1em12 = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 1e-12, 0.5)
z_xu_1em6  = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 1e-6, 0.5)
z_xu_1em3  = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 1e-3, 0.5)
z_cf_1em12 = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 1e-12, 0.5)
z_cf_1em12_c1 = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 1e-12, 1)

{ --- NTU -> inf : the reachable-effectiveness ceiling of each arrangement --- }
i_cf_100   = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 100, 0.5)
i_cf_1e3   = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 1000, 0.5)
i_cf_1e30  = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 1e30, 0.5)
i_cf_1e30_c1 = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 1e30, 1)
i_cf_1e300_c1 = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 1e300, 1)
i_pf_1e30  = hx_effectiveness('parallelflow', 1e30, 0.5)
i_pf_1e30_c1 = hx_effectiveness('parallelflow', 1e30, 1)
i_xu_100   = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 100, 0.5)
i_xu_1e30  = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 1e30, 0.5)
i_xu_1e300 = hx_effectiveness('crossflowbothunmixed', 1e300, 0.5)
i_xmax_1e30 = hx_effectiveness('crossflowcmaxmixed', 1e30, 0.5)
i_xmin_1e30 = hx_effectiveness('crossflowcminmixed', 1e30, 0.5)
i_st_1e30  = hx_effectiveness('shelltube', 1e30, 0.5)
i_st_100   = hx_effectiveness('shelltube', 100, 0.5)
i_cr0_1e30 = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 1e30, 0)
i_cr0_1e300 = hx_effectiveness('shelltube', 1e300, 0)

{ --- Cr = 1 exactly, and either side of the |cr - 1| < 1e-10 guard --- }
c1_exact   = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 2, 1)
c1_minus   = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 2, 0.99999999995)
c1_minus2  = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 2, 0.9999999999)
c1_minus3  = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 2, 0.999999999)
c1_far     = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', 2, 0.99)

{ --- every alias spelling, same numbers --- }
a_counter  = hx_effectiveness('counter', 1.7, 0.42)
a_countercur = hx_effectiveness('countercurrent', 1.7, 0.42)
a_parallel = hx_effectiveness('parallel', 1.7, 0.42)
a_cocurrent = hx_effectiveness('cocurrent', 1.7, 0.42)
a_coflow   = hx_effectiveness('coflow', 1.7, 0.42)
a_crossflow = hx_effectiveness('crossflow', 1.7, 0.42)
a_crossbu  = hx_effectiveness('crossbothunmixed', 1.7, 0.42)
a_cmaxmix  = hx_effectiveness('cmaxmixed', 1.7, 0.42)
a_cminunmix = hx_effectiveness('crossflowcminunmixed', 1.7, 0.42)
a_cminmix  = hx_effectiveness('cminmixed', 1.7, 0.42)
a_cmaxunmix = hx_effectiveness('crossflowcmaxunmixed', 1.7, 0.42)
a_shell    = hx_effectiveness('shell', 1.7, 0.42)
a_shelltube = hx_effectiveness('shellandtube', 1.7, 0.42)
a_st1      = hx_effectiveness('shellandtube1', 1.7, 0.42)
a_eps      = hx_epsilon('counter', 1.7, 0.42)

{ --- the inverse NTU(eps, Cr): eps -> 0, and eps just under each ceiling --- }
n_cf_tiny  = hx_ntu('counterflow', 1e-12, 0.5)
n_cf_mid   = hx_ntu('counterflow', 0.8, 0.5)
n_cf_c1    = hx_ntu('counterflow', 0.8, 1)
n_cf_near1 = hx_ntu('counterflow', 0.999999999, 0.5)
n_cr0      = hx_ntu('counterflow', 0.5, 0)
n_pf_near  = hx_ntu('parallelflow', 0.6666666, 0.5)
n_xu_tiny  = hx_ntu('crossflowbothunmixed', 1e-9, 0.5)
n_xu_mid   = hx_ntu('crossflowbothunmixed', 0.8, 0.5)
n_xmax     = hx_ntu('crossflowcmaxmixed', 0.7, 0.5)
n_xmin     = hx_ntu('crossflowcminmixed', 0.8, 0.5)
n_st       = hx_ntu('shelltube', 0.6, 0.5)

{ --- LMTD removable singularity: |dt1 - dt2| < 1e-12 * max --- }
l_equal    = lmtd(10, 10)
l_near     = lmtd(10, 10.000000000001)
l_near2    = lmtd(10, 10.0000000000001)
l_normal   = lmtd(40, 10)
l_tiny     = lmtd(1e-9, 1e-9)
l_wide     = lmtd(1e6, 1e-6)

{ --- fin efficiency across its mL < 1e-8 short-circuit --- }
f_0        = fin_efficiency(0)
f_below    = fin_efficiency(9.999999e-9)
f_at       = fin_efficiency(1e-8)
f_above    = fin_efficiency(1.0000001e-8)
f_1        = fin_efficiency(1)
f_big      = fin_efficiency(1000)
